android.desc:
AdventureQuest 3D MMORPG – Battle, Build, and Become a Legend

Enter a living, growing multiplayer fantasy world where you can fight dragons, build anything, and explore epic storylines — all alongside friends across mobile, Steam, and PC. AQ3D is the cross-platform MMORPG with weekly updates, wild customization, no pay-to-win, and endless ways to play.

🏰 NEW: SANDBOX HOUSING IS HERE

Build anything you can imagine. Sandbox housing lets you:

• Place, rotate, scale, and stack items freely
• Build castles, obstacle courses, theme parks — even flying sofas
• Create personal hangouts or insane parkour challenges for friends
• It’s chaotic, creative, and completely physics-free

No blueprints. No limits. Just imagination (and probably dragons).

🧙 CREATE YOUR HERO, YOUR WAY

• Customize your character’s look and gear with over 7,000 items
• Equip any item for power or style (transmog included)
• Change classes anytime: warrior, mage, rogue, ninja, necromancer & more
• Morph into 200+ travel forms: dragons, ghosts, birds, wolves, even bushes
• Ride on our newest Mounts for fast-travel and fierce looks

Be yourself. Or something much weirder. No judgement!

🔥FIGHT, RAID, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER

• 5-player dungeons and 20-player raids
• Open-world bosses and seasonal scaled maps
• 5v5 PvP battlegrounds and challenge fights
• Epic loot, legendary weapons, and fashionably questionable outfits await

Whether soloing in the shadows, leading your guild into battle, or climbing the ranks in PvP, there’s always a fight to win… or flee from heroically.

🌍TRULY CROSS-PLATFORM

• Play on iOS, Android, Steam, Mac, and PC
• One account, one world — all devices log into the same universe
• Cloud save, real-time co-op, and zero platform restrictions
• Doesn’t hog space (download size under 250MB)

Take the full MMO experience from phone to desktop and back again without missing a beat.

🎉WEEKLY EVENTS & FREE CONTENT

We never stop updating. Expect:

• New quests, items, and gear every week
• Special events and rotating challenge content
• Player suggested updates, weird experiments, and community surprises

From Trobblemania to Mogloween, there’s always something weird happening in AQ3D.

🧑‍🎓OLD SCHOOL SOUL. MODERN DAY CHAOS.

From the creators of AdventureQuest, DragonFable, and AQWorlds comes a full 3D reimagining of the browser MMOs you loved growing up.

• Return to iconic zones like Battleon, Darkovia, Ashfall, and D

> Hint: If the game has its own currency (coins, diamonds, etc) which you can buy for real money, it's bullshit and you shouldn't submit it.

But there are games where you can use real money to buy golds and diamonds and spend them purely on cosmetics like costumes, pets etc.

They don't give you any advantage in game play or progression.

An example is Adventure Quest 3D. From their Google Play description:

NOT PAY-TO-WIN

- Finally, an MMO that's not going to wreck your wallet

- Earn power & cool items through gameplay. Wow, what a concept!

- Optional cosmetics if you’d like to support us… and our anime obsession ^_^

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.battleon.aq3d
